sources.title: Qwen2.5-7B QLoRA Fine-tuning Guide - GitHub
sources.snippet: This repository provides a complete, production-ready implementation for fine-tuning Qwen2.5-7B using QLoRA (Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation). QLoRA enables efficient fine-tuning of large language models on consumer-grade GPUs by using 4-bit quantization.

sources.snippet: Qwen2.5 is the latest series of Qwen large language models. For Qwen2.5, we release a number of base language models and instruction-tuned language models ranging from 0.5 to 72 billion parameters.
